## Summary table


::: {#tbl-summary .cell tbl-cap='Summary statistics per group.'}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_summary <- df_data |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(value),
    sd = sd(value),
    count = dplyr::n(),
    .by = group
  )

knitr::kable(df_summary, digits = 2)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}


|group |  mean|   sd| count|
|:-----|-----:|----:|-----:|
|A     | -0.04| 1.15|    50|
|B     |  1.60| 0.92|    50|
|C     |  2.85| 0.93|    50|


:::
:::


@tbl-summary summarises the simulated data.

## Distribution


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot2::ggplot(df_data, ggplot2::aes(value, fill = group)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 15, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
